::: {.obsidian-sla}
:::

State the purpose and scope of the agreement in one paragraph. Name
the service covered and the parties bound.

# Service levels

State the service levels. Name the availability target, the
response times, and the measurement period.

| Level | Target | Measurement |
|---|---|---|
| Availability | 99.5 percent | Monthly |
| Response | 4 business hours | Per request |

# Service credits

State the credits for missed levels. Name the amount and the
mechanism of recovery.

# Support schedule

State the support hours, the escalation path, and the emergency
provisions.

# Exclusions

State what the agreement does not cover and the conditions that
suspend the levels.
